note: The buildings of the park as it was from 1957 to 1996. Which there were, their number and their type (A4, A6, B4, B6) are those of the park's own map (raw/park_brochures); their positions those of the topographic maps (raw/topotijdreis) where these have them, RD New (EPSG:28992), metres, good to about 5 m. Made by tools/make_old_park.py. The door, and so the model, follows from the type in data/type_models.json. kind: Bungalow or Chalet. front_azimuth: the way the front door faces, degrees clockwise from north. What is not known is 'Unknown'. source.position: where the position is from; park_map_off: how far the park map, fitted, has it from there [m]. today: the nearest house of today. others: buildings that are not bungalows: the middle of the part under the main roof, the way the front faces, and the length of the front on the park map. roads: the roads of the old park, all unpaved, from the park map: kind Ring, Road or Path, width [m], the line through its middle, on_road_of_today: the part of it that was laid on a road of today, over_bungalow: whether a road of today that runs over an old bungalow was left for the park map.

buildings.name: Grutto
buildings.evidence: Its front door faces west (Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21). The number 12 is on its door frame in the photograph of the door. 'From Grutto in direction of outlook tower' was taken 12 m from it, by the bearings to the tower and to six buildings, and 'Grutto (yellow)' 13 m from it, on the dune behind it. Its front is seen square on from the field in 'Grutto (right) and Tureluur (middle)', taken looking 68 degrees, which gave about 255.

buildings.name: Tureluur
buildings.evidence: Its front door faces west-south-west (Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21). Left of Grutto and a quarter further away in 'Grutto (right) and Tureluur (middle)', 2 m from the line of sight; behind Grutto in 'Grutto with Tureluur in the background'. Has a brick chimney. Its front door faces south-west (Jan de Kort, 2026-11-21).
